name: Deep In Love
description: In a land where people are accustomed to battling fierce waves and constant storms, the story of a woman who stands tall on her feet, with all her emotional strength, resilience and endurance, and a man who is passionate about his "love" and who competes with the storms of the Black Sea and struggles with its waves, comes to the screens with an effective script... The ups and downs of the mountains, the sea and the human soul are told through the eyes of a stranger who finds himself in the middle of the endless war between two mortal enemies.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The never-ending war between two rival families, the Furtuna family and the Koçari family, has been raging for years. Adil Koçari and Esme Furtuna, who had a deep-seated love affair in the past, clashed over blood rights, and Esme shot Adil. Despite all the animosity between them, Adil Koçari refused to betray Esme Furtuna, claiming, "I shot myself." Just then, a Greek doctor from far away saves Adil's life. The daughter of a Greek mother and a Greek father from Istanbul, this girl has come to Trabzon in pursuit of a great secret. After Eleni's arrival, life will never be the same for either Adil or Esme.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Adil and Eleni, in an accident, are caught in the middle of an ambush set by Gökhan and his men, struggling to survive amidst the bullets. Esme comes to their aid. Adil is determined to hold Eleni's attackers accountable. As rumors of the "Greek doctor and Koçari together" grow in the village, Oruç's engagement preparations to Sevcan accelerate. However, denied shelter in the village, Eleni falls exhausted and ill. Encountering Eleni on the beach, Oruç helps her and entrusts her to Esme. Despite the village's opposition, Esme cares for Eleni "like a daughter." Meanwhile, during the engagement ceremony, Adil arrives to reclaim the land bequeathed to him "by blood right," bringing Esme and Adil face to face. Meanwhile, Şerif orders Eleni's death while in prison. Eleni, however, is unaware of the danger that awaits her.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After being attacked, Eleni falls into the sea and is rescued by Oruç, who takes her to Esme’s guesthouse. Unable to see her attacker, Eleni finds it impossible to trust anyone and insists on seeing only Adil. When Adil, Esme, and Eleni reunite at the guesthouse, they begin searching for the person behind the assault. Meanwhile, Adil learns that Fadime has gone missing. Zarife makes him a ruthless offer: “Return the land, and you can have your sister back.” But this bargain once again forces the Furtuna family to face the harsh hand of “Koçari justice.” Just as tensions reach their peak, the unexpected return of Şerif Furtuna shatters the balance completely, setting the stage for a new wave of conflict.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: With Şerif's release from prison, everything shifts. As tensions rise again on the Furtuna front, Adil decides to erase the traces of the past. He challenges Esme, who refuses to reveal who threw Eleni into the sea. If she remains silent, he will destroy her boarding house and all of Furtuna. Oruç's trust in his uncle is shaken by Melina's words, "Your uncle sold Eleni out." This time, it's Oruç's turn to demand an explanation. Behçet, meanwhile, lures Eleni into a trap he's set on the plateau, using the pretext of help. Upon receiving the news of Eleni's death, Oruç is devastated by the grief of not being able to protect her.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Adil destroys Esme's guesthouse, obliterating the past. He closes his case with Esme, but launches a massive lawsuit against the Furtuna people. Despite Esme's best efforts to stop him, he continues his game with various moves and ultimately succeeds in breaking the villagers' trust in Şerif and the Furtuna family. However, at the same time, Şerif has launched a ruthless plan against him: poisoning the tens of thousands of goat herd to reclaim the land and the money! Meanwhile, the photo Melina gave Oruç reveals that Eleni was sold in Istanbul as a baby. Eleni decides to go to Istanbul with Oruç to find her mother. Eleni's refusal to listen to Adil and leaving him behind deeply shakes Adil. Esme, while fighting side by side with Adil for the goats, is devastated to learn that Eleni is searching for her mother and that she is a Furtuna person.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Adil, Eleni, and Oruç set off from Istanbul on the Koçari Jet to the Black Sea to find Sultan Ebe, who sold Eleni. Before the plane even takes off, they embark on an adventure, with Adil attempting to dismember Oruç in the jet's engine. Şerif's ambush, designed to prevent them from following Sultan Ebe's trail, puts Adil and Gezep in mortal danger. Finally, realizing that the Furtunas were the ones who sold Eleni, Adil is enraged. Esme's assumption that Şerif is staying in a hotel room with her further shakes Adil. To stop Adil, Şerif attacks and harms the villagers working on his land and the Koçaris, leaving many injured.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Oruç's return to Koçari has dire consequences. Adil imposes a severe punishment on the Furtunas. He burns their tea factories, blows up their trucks, throws their men into the tea cutting machine, and makes life hell for the Furtunas. Amidst all this chaos, Esme confronts Oruç, declaring that if Eleni is his daughter, she will divorce Şerif and become the Furtunas' greatest enemy. Not only that, she also tells Adil not to believe the Furtunas, so he can get the test he couldn't get himself. Esme's blazing-fast attitude plunges Adil into maddening doubt. Is Eleni their daughter? Adil will only trust one of them; that same day, he brings Gezep's biologist twin, İlve, to Koçari for a DNA test. İlve, the witness and architect of Adil and Esme's love affair in the past, is a lifeline for both Adil and Esme. İlve performs the DNA test. All this chaos changes Gezep's life as well. The wound he hides beneath his cheerful, wild personality begins to bleed again.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: When Eleni learns that Esme and Adil have a baby, she's heartbroken that Esme is carrying all this burden alone and pressures Esme to share it with Adil. But Esme refuses. Adil, though heartbroken, respects Eleni's decision to leave but asks for time to hold her accountable for what the Furtunas have put her through. Eleni only gives him one day; she'll leave the next. Adil takes action. When he learns that Esme's father fell off a cliff while trying to throw Esme, he demands an explanation for Esme as well. He takes Hicran to the edge of the cliff and ensures Şirin Furtuna hears that Şerif tried to kill Eleni.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Adil faces the truth. He and Esme had a baby, and now she's in the grave. Adil is devastated for Esme, who has endured this pain alone for twenty years. Unable to embrace their love, the two lovers grieve together. They confront each other and weep. As Eleni is about to leave Greece for America, an unexpected guest arrives: Oruç! Adil and Esme inflict the ultimate punishment on the Furtunians: exile! They must leave the Black Sea region within twenty days. Zarife's solution to this exile hinges on Eleni's return. Since the Koçaris haven't given Fadime to İso, Oruç will take Eleni and end the feud.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The conflict between Koçari and Furtuna escalates into a major crisis when Adil blows up the mansion. Caught in the middle of the explosion, Esme narrowly escapes death and finds the truth she's been searching for: Eleni. Esme is overjoyed, yet also determined to settle accounts with the Furtunas. Now she has a clear goal: will her daughter call her mother and Adil father? Oruç focuses on doing everything necessary to protect his family, while struggling to cope with the Koçari's relentless moves. Knowing that Adil is searching for him everywhere, Şerif kidnaps Esme.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Sheriff threatens Esme, saying he will frame Adil for Ballı's murder in court if she divorces him. Esme is determined not to give in to this threat and not to remain silent. Meanwhile, Oruç reports Adil for blowing up the mansion, and Adil is arrested. With only two days left until the divorce hearing, Esme, along with Fadime and Eleni, embarks on a race against time to save the man she loves. Eleni's crucial solution comes as a huge surprise to everyone. Meanwhile, Oruç has taken control and declared war on his uncle. The wedding preparations proceeding before her eyes drive Eleni mad. She is also fed up with what is being done to Adil and Esme. She decides to deliver her first major punishment and exposes Sevcan's secrets at the henna night.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: The day before Esme's divorce hearing, Adil takes Hicran and Eleni out to dinner to explain to Esme the pain of her returning to the mansion. But Esme's unexpected response will strike Adil right in the heart. Eleni's heart, meanwhile, is shattered by Oruç's decision to marry Sevcan. But something Oruç does before the wedding deeply shakes them both. Now the wedding is a moment of destiny for Oruç. He will either marry Eleni's killer to protect his family, or he will sacrifice his own family to allow Eleni to be reunited with hers. Esme works tirelessly for the day her family will be reunited. She returns to the mansion to defeat Şerif. Şerif achieves a great victory against both Adil and Oruç. Adil is determined to make Şerif pay for this victory with his life. But that wedding...

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The shooting of Şerif turns Furtuna into a scene of utter chaos. Adil, unwilling to send Esme to jail, tries to take the blame. Esme, however, is determined to surrender to prevent Adil from going back to prison. The question of who will take the blame in this predicament sparks great curiosity. Meanwhile, Eleni and Oruç embark on a relentless race against time for Sevcan, who has been taken to the health center with suspected poisoning. Their greatest concern is whether Sevcan will survive. Adil and Oruç make a secret deal to end Şerif's dark dealings. According to this plan, İso will play a key role as the closest person to his uncle. However, the price Şerif demands for trusting İso is extremely high. Then, unexpectedly, İso and Fadime appear hand in hand, dropping a bombshell. What kind of storm will this alliance unleash between the two feuding families?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The sudden marriage of İso and Fadime sends shockwaves through both families. Adil refuses to accept this marriage; he forcibly takes Fadime to the Koçari Mansion and detains İso as well. The Furtuna family pursues them to rescue İso and reclaim Fadime. At Taş Köprü, the Koçaris and the Furtunas come face-to-face; during the ensuing massive clash, Oruç is shot. On the other hand, Eleni is shaken when she learns that Oruç has been critically injured. With Oruç in mortal danger, he urgently needs surgery. Eleni seeks help from her mother Melina to save him. For Melina, who is collaborating with the prosecutor to protect her daughter, the long-awaited opportunity has finally arrived. In a move that surprises everyone, Adil announces that he accepts his marriage to Fadime and calls the Furtunas to formally request her hand. However, when Esme enters the Koçari Mansion on Şerif’s arm, it strikes Adil at his core. Yet Adil also has a major surprise planned for the Furtunas.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Adil Koçari holding Esme's hand in front of Şerif Furtuna drives Şerif mad. He imprisons Esme and forbids her from seeing her daughter. Now Esme is imprisoned in the mansion, while Eleni is in an interrogation room at the police station. Despite all the difficulties, the three try to find a way to be together. Oruç, besides the pain of separating Eleni from her family, also bears the burden of her losing her job. Learning that his uncle has imprisoned his aunt will put his life in danger. Fadime and İso find themselves caught between Adil, who has sworn not to let another life be lost in the Furtuna Mansion, and Zarife, who has vowed to take Fadime as a bride to the mansion. Eyüphan's kidnapping of Fadime leads to an unexpected surprise. The moments they experience with her brother during the bride-taking ceremony deeply shake both Fadime and Adil. In a fragile atmosphere of peace, everyone at the wedding is like a ticking time bomb. However, the one who will pull the pin is Eleni.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: After the wedding, İso and Fadime, unaware of everything that has happened, start to get to know each other better during their forced honeymoon at the mountain house. İso learns the meaning of the beads in Fadime’s braid and is devastated. Adil, who just married off his sister and discovers there’s a secret that could ruin the peace, and realizes that Esme knows it too, feels nothing left in his heart. He burns his bridges, abandons waiting for the weapon to be found, and confronts Esme. However, Şerif’s betrayal puts Adil in a difficult position. The possibility of losing both Adil and Eleni shatters Esme. She unleashes her anger in Furtuna Mansion, determined to make Şerif regret his actions. Adil’s first step in his plan to completely eliminate Şerif leads Oruç, torn between his love for Eleni and his family, to the edge of the road. Eleni is devastated by this punishment. With Adil now targeting Esme, the stakes are clear: they will either burn together or burn apart.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Esme channels the pain of the breakup into Fırtına Mansion, focusing all her energy on finding the gun. Determined to locate the weapon, divorce Şerif, and free herself from both Şerif and Hicran. Meanwhile, Adil vents his own anger through his neglected goats and sets his sights on eliminating Şerif. Oruç and İso are pushed into a life-or-death trial along this path. Fadime, pleading with her brother for İso’s life, confronts her own feelings for the first time. Oruç, on the verge of losing his career and facing a new life, is shaken by Eleni’s unwavering support while simultaneously plotting with Adil to remove his uncle from power. Yet Şerif’s proposal to Eleni shocks them both. Amirum Dayı persuades Adil to marry, asking, “You left Esme, Fadime married İso....will the Koçari line continue from Fırtına?” Adil begins searching for a suitable bride, but Esme crashes Adil’s meeting, only to be blindsided by what she sees.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Eleni, whose dream world built around Adil and Esme is shaken, decides to face reality and stands on the brink of a major turning point in her life, one that forces both Esme and Adil to question themselves. Meanwhile, Esme confronts Oruç, and Amirum Dayı presents Adil with numerous potential brides, but Adil finds excuses to reject them all and instead focuses on tracking down the gun. As Fadime and İso get closer to finding the gun, they are also forced to confront the reality that they will divorce once Şerif goes to prison. While Oruç struggles with feelings for Eleni that he can no longer resist, he also faces mounting crises within both the family and the factory as president, along with increasing pressure from Zarife to marry Eleni. Having lost both Esme and his leadership, Şerif spirals out of control, burying Adil’s gun beside a corpse and tipping off the police. Now, for everyone involved, the game has reached its final stage.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: As Adil goes mad with worry and panic, Esme is savoring that unique feeling of freedom from being rid of Şerif after twenty years, while also gathering strength and making plans for her great battle. When Adil learns that Esme left because she “didn’t know a single Muslim who would sit at her table during Ramadan,” he is devastated and goes to the highlands, setting up camp at the door of the woman he loves. Meanwhile, Zarife steadfastly continues her efforts to marry the two off, but she encounters a big surprise. With Şerif’s imprisonment, İso and Fadime decide to divorce. However, with this decision, they begin to realize how difficult it is to break away from each other. Eyüphan devises a dangerous plan and sabotages the brakes of İso’s pickup truck. But it is not İso who gets into that pickup—it is Eleni and Fadime, who want to have their first iftar with Esme. They crash in the pickup with failed brakes. Who will survive this terrible accident now depends only on a miracle.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Eleni and Fadime are found on the verge of freezing in the snow, and a great struggle for survival begins for them. This struggle leads to a deepening of Adil's relationship with Oruç and İso. Esme and Adil also set aside their disagreements during this process. They embrace each other and try to save Eleni and Fadime. Eleni's teetering between life and death makes Oruç realize how lonely he would be without her. İso and Fadime, on the other hand, become aware of how much they value each other and, hesitantly, begin to express their feelings for the first time. But Fadime's confession drives İso mad. Şerif and Zarife, realizing the pickup truck's brakes have been cut, use it to bring Fadime to Furtuna Mansion and keep Esme at the mansion. However, Adil has a big surprise for them. Şerif goes after Esme. Esme, meanwhile, triggers the earthquake that will bring Furtuna's end, telling everything to Gezep. But Gezep is not the only one she tells.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Gezep is overjoyed when he learns that Eleni is the daughter of Adil and Esme. But he goes mad when he realizes that Esme and İlve have been keeping this secret for a long time. Adil's expulsion of Eyüphan from Koçari and his granting of the right to punish to İso causes great unrest in the two enemy villages. In the chaos instigated by Şerif, Oruç's leadership is tested. The right to blood belongs to the Furtunalıs, and Oruç must find a solution that will not fuel the animosity. The bond between Eleni and Oruç grows stronger. İso and Fadime confront for the first time the depth of the enmity they are children of. This confrontation deeply shakes them both. Adil's goats are released by the villagers, and his pens are emptied. But he never leaves Esme's side, whom he wants to protect from Şerif. However, Esme cannot overcome her resentment towards Adil. Hicran's attempt to steal Eleni from Esme brings Esme to the brink of a crisis that will shock everyone.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Adil learns that Esme, seeing the dreams of the life they could have had, attacked Hicran, and he is deeply shaken. He forgets the problems between them and devotes himself to Esme. Eleni, intervening with the injured Hicran, notices something amiss on the ultrasound. Driven by the suspicion "How did Hicran give birth to me?" she pursues the truth. Due to the Eyüphan issue, Adil's thousands of goats are released into the mountains in Koçari, and a major rebellion against Oruç begins in Furtuna. Amid this chaos, Şerif tries to kidnap Eleni to dissuade Esme from divorce. Fadime, torn between her blood feud and her feelings, panics when İso starts acting distant toward her. She begins following İso around and tries to talk to him about her emotions. Şerif, shaken by Şirin Furtuna's acceptance of giving all her assets to Oruç, has Sevcan drug Emine to make her miscarry the baby in order to prevent Esme from divorcing.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: While Adil saves Emine's baby, Eleni and Oruç bring Emine back to life, whom İso and Fadime had found. However, Şerif's attempts to prevent his divorce from Esme continue. The Koçari and Furtuna servants all work tirelessly to ensure Esme gets the divorce. While Emine is in the hospital, Adil and Esme look after her baby. Facing a situation similar to the life they couldn't live together deeply shakes them both. Hicran and Zarife try to prevent Eleni from finding out who she is, while Oruç confronts his mother. But none of them know about Eleni's whereabouts. Thanks to İso, Fadime and İso's relationship takes a major step forward and becomes very strong. But Eyüphan gets a powerful advantage. Şerif constantly tries to incite Adil about his relationship with Esme, but Esme proves that their marriage was only on paper and gets a divorce.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: While Esme's divorce from Şerif is being celebrated in Koçari, Şerif unleashes a catastrophe for the Koçari family. He blows up the Koçari family's cold storage facility in Russia, poisoning the village's water supply. He lures Adil into a death trap in Russia while preparing to take Esme far away. Meanwhile, Esme and Adil take significant steps towards not just loving each other, but understanding each other, and get closer to having Şerif imprisoned. Esme learns that Zarife is also involved in child trafficking. Eleni secretly decides to have her own DNA test done. At the same time, she makes plans to make Oruç tell the truth and begins to shake him. Oruç struggles to resist these plans that are turning his emotions upside down. At the mountain house, Fadime shares her soul and fears with İso in the most open way. This sharing brings them very close. Fadime takes the picture of a flying hawk that İso always drew as a child.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Esme and Eleni join forces, managing the chaos created by Şerif's attempt to poison all of Koçari and abduct Esme, and luring her into Adil's cleverly devised trap. Fadime, while frantically worried about İso, fights against Şerif's thirty men alongside her brother. Eleni manages to keep everyone alive until the ambulances arrive by setting up a triage area. Oruç, poisoned, uses his last medicine at the cost of his own life to save his enemy, Gezep. When Esme shows no fear of what Adil will do to Şerif even in such a wicked act, Adil realizes that the secret Esme is hiding is something far bigger. As his journey to the truth begins, he approaches it in a way Esme never expected. While Zarife's past sins are revealed before everyone's eyes, Eleni continues her resolute pursuit of the truth.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: When Esme is accused and injured at the water tank, Adil loses control. He makes those responsible pay for their actions. Only Esme can stop Adil, who is blinded by rage. There, she leads the Koçari family and, defying the Furtunas' enmity, leaves hand in hand with Adil through the crowd. Oruç, very worried about İso, takes revenge on Eyüphan. However, Eleni saves Eyüphan from the vehicle about to explode and asks Adil for help. Esme, determined to "turn hell into heaven," convinces Oruç, who doesn't want İso to tell Adil the truth. In the great confrontation at the Koçari Mansion, Adil learns that İso and Fadime were forced into marriage, and he reacts in a way that deeply shakes them all. Esme, once again managing the Koçari family and Adil's anger, saves Şerif's life and his family's future, while Şirin threatens Eleni to take Şerif away from them.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Şirin's kidnapping of Eleni to reunite with her son throws everyone's lives into an irreversible situation. Esme is shattered by the fear of losing her daughter once again. Adil is on the verge of going mad from what he heard from Niko. Although his logic dictates a different truth, his heart cannot give up on Eleni. To save Eleni, Adil agrees to make a trade with Şerif, his lifelong enemy. Esme, on the other hand, is determined to break her twenty-year silence and tell everything the moment she is reunited with her daughter. Perhaps for the first time, fate has come so close to healing their wounds. The road leads them to where it all began: the Sümela Monastery. However, in that historical place they went to with hope, fate has prepared a completely different ending for them all. The exchange, which was supposed to take place peacefully, is suddenly stained with blood by the gun that Hicran secretly smuggled in. Şerif's bullet cuts through the twenty-year longing right in the middle.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: As the woman he loves hovers between life and death, Adil confronts the greatest truth of his life: Eleni is his daughter. Without hesitation, Adil leaps into the dark waters of the Black Sea in pursuit of her, but he cannot reach her. His daughter is taken to a place unknown to the world, in the hands of Şerif. However, Eleni does not surrender; she turns Şerif's life into hell, leaving traces behind and making everyone feel that she is Adil's daughter. When Esme regains consciousness, a heavy confrontation takes place between Adil and Esme. As Adil changes with each truth he learns, what truly frightens Esme is not his anger, but his icy calmness. The fear of losing both the woman he loves and his daughter at the same time has unleashed the darkness within him. The offer Adil makes to Esme in Georgia, where they went in pursuit of Eleni, deeply shakes Esme. Driven by the desire to save his daughter, Adil, who has stayed away from the darkness for years

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Adil, who tells Volkov he will marry his daughter to save her, secretly devises a much bigger plan, defeating Timur Volkov and gaining a formidable enemy. However, this also allows him to learn his daughter's whereabouts. Esme, wanting to go to Şerif to prevent her daughter's death and finding Adil's plan to rescue Eleni too risky, confronts Adil. Esme wins the fight between the two angry lovers. However, Adil is shot just as he is about to board the same boat. After eliminating Adil, Zarife tells Şerif that Esme was the one who betrayed him twenty years ago, aiming to eliminate Esme as well. Şerif orders Eleni's murder in front of Esme. But just when everyone thinks it's all over, those who worked to change their destinies will deserve to be reunited.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: On the Stone Bridge, the pass separating the villages of Koçari and Furtuna, where the three of them first walked together, they are reborn as a family. The people of Furtuna are shaken by the shock of Adil being alive, but an even bigger surprise awaits them. Because Esme, Adil, and Eleni have now become one heart and one anger. The Koçari people vow to exact revenge for their stolen holiday and a lifetime of pain. Even Oruç, who brought a false mother to Eleni, and İso, who lied to Fadime, will not be exempt from this reckoning. The great war has officially begun, and the sea is about to overflow
